actuator_guard.scope: all training environments since last log; 200 Hz, including resets

stair_speed.criterion: eligible forward exit > 4m without physical termination; not independent stair completion
stair_speed.statistics_mode: cumulative stochastic training episodes; no automatic speed-weight adjustment

pit.acceptance: all wheels supported on top, full collision body past edge, quiet/upright for 2s
pit.stop_protocol: external perfect-state stop command on platform; not autonomous student detection
pit.course_evidence: disjoint stochastic training batches; not independent held-out evaluation
pit.course_metric: full-body climb confirmed for 0.2s; body remains past edge and no physical failure or lane exit at episode end
